from tinydb import TinyDB, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert_multiple([
    {'name': 'Alice'},
    {'name': 'Alan'},
    {'name': 'bob'},
])

# Test caching - same query should return same hash
q1 = where('name').startswith('Al')
q2 = where('name').startswith('Al')
q3 = where('name').startswith('Alx')

print('q1 hash:', hash(q1))
print('q2 hash:', hash(q2))
print('q3 hash:', hash(q3))
print('q1 == q2:', q1 == q2)
print('q1 == q3:', q1 == q3)

# Test endswith caching
q4 = where('name').endswith('ce')
q5 = where('name').endswith('ce')
print('q4 hash:', hash(q4))
print('q5 hash:', hash(q5))
print('q4 == q5:', q4 == q5)

# Test combined queries
q6 = where('name').startswith('Al') & where('name').endswith('e')
print('combined:', [d['name'] for d in db.search(q6)])
""}
